channel.name: LCIIS - HL7 ORU Ingestion
channel.description: Listens for HL7 v2.x ORU^R01 lab result messages over TCP/MLLP from the hospital LIS, parses the PID/PV1/OBX segments, and POSTs one JSON payload per OBX result to the LCIIS backend's /api/lab-result endpoint. See hl7/README.md and hl7/hl7_parser.py for the equivalent standalone-bridge implementation of this same logic.

com.mirth.connect.plugins.javascriptstep.name: Parse HL7 ORU and build LCIIS payloads

com.mirth.connect.plugins.javascriptrule.name: Only accept ORU^R01

connector.name: Post lab results to LCIIS API
